name: Symbiox Investment & Trading Co Ltd
about: Symbiox Investment & Trading Co Ltd engages in the trading of textile products in India. The company offers traditional handloom, handicrafts, wool and silk products; garments, gunny, hessian, carper backing, tarpoline cloth, jute cutting, raw jute, and textile; and fabrics, carpets, durries, mats, rugs, blankets, shawls, tweeds, linens, flannels, bed spreads, quilts, scares, belts, polyester, fiber, yarn, hosiery and mixed fabrics natural silk fabrics and garments, as well as furnishing and all sorts of apparels dressing materials mixed nylon. It deals in shares, stocks, debentures, bonds, and obligations and securities issued or guarantees. The company sells its products through wholesalers and retailers. Symbiox Investment & Trading Co. Ltd. was incorporated in 1979 and is based in Kolkata, India.
